title: Mark Leonard’s World in 30 minutes – European Council on Foreign Relations
gist: Index page for ECFR's weekly 'Mark Leonard's World in 30 minutes' podcast listing recent episode titles and guests; it holds no substantive analysis beyond topic blurbs.

insights.claim: ECFR's podcast lists an October 2026 episode on Europe's response to the second China shock, with Mark Leonard and Andrew Small.
insights.speaker: European Council on Foreign Relations
insights.so_what: Shows China overcapacity is a live European policy theme.

insights.claim: ECFR's podcast flags a looming major food crisis, with Cary Fowler and Jim O'Brien discussing Europe's role in preventing it.
insights.speaker: European Council on Foreign Relations
insights.so_what: Food-security risk is on the European policy agenda; watch agricultural commodity stress.
insights.locator: escalating risk of a major food crisis
